public_rationale: Anthropic announced $3.5 billion in financing on March 3, 2025 and a $13 billion round on September 2, 2025, establishing a larger later round at one developer [e2, e1]. CB Insights reported that average financing deal size across private AI companies globally rose 86% in January–September 2025 compared with 2024 [e3]. Neither individual round sizes nor an all-AI average supplies comparable aggregate investment totals for LLM/transformer development, so these items establish neither continued growth nor a flat or declining trend for the claimed investment [e1, e2, e3].
limitations: The evidence lacks a comparable aggregate series isolating LLM/transformer investment in Q3 2025 and earlier periods.
Financing received does not establish expenditure on the specified development approach.
CB Insights covers AI broadly; its report was published on October 30, 2025, after the claim.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Investments in the single LLM/transformer approach continue to grow.

statement.excerpt: Yet investments in the same single approach grow every day.
statement.document_title: Could China devastate the US without firing a shot?

our_interpretation: Every day is ordinary emphasis for a continuing upward trend, not a claim that funding increases on every calendar day.
The same approach refers to LLM/transformer development in the preceding discussion.
Growth requires a comparable investment measure over time; merely adding another transaction to a cumulative total is insufficient.
Use the third quarter of 2025 as the latest completed investment reporting quarter before publication, with earlier periods as comparison context.
The wording does not choose between financing received, capital expenditure, or future commitments, and supplies no reporting basis.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable records show a continuing upward trend in investment attributable to LLM/transformer development during the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records show that investment attributable to that approach was flat or declining over a meaningful comparison interval.

The earlier round was smaller than September's round. This is a company-level financing comparison, not a sector-wide investment growth rate.
